mapper.select: select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Start_Time as secStartTime, sec.Sec_Bidding_Cycle as secBiddingCycle, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Trading_Place as secTradingPlace, c1.C_Name as seCpyName, c1.C_Abbreviation as seCpyAbbName, c2.C_Name as tendereeName, c2.C_Abbreviation as tendereeAbbName, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, c3.C_Name as secAgencyName, mn.* from Sec_Entrust mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Se_Cpy_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_ID = sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_ID = sec.Sec_Agency left join Sys_File f on f.FileId = mn.id where mn.id = #{id}

select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Start_Time as secStartTime, sec.Sec_Bidding_Cycle as secBiddingCycle, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Trading_Place as secTradingPlace, c1.C_Name as seCpyName, c1.C_Abbreviation as seCpyAbbName, c2.C_Name as tendereeName, c2.C_Abbreviation as tendereeAbbName, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, c3.C_Name as secAgencyName, mn.* from Sec_Entrust mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Se_Cpy_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_ID = sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_ID = sec.Sec_Agency left join Sys_File f on f.FileId = mn.id where mn.Sec_Id = #{secId} and mn.State = 7 order by mn.State_Time desc limit 1
